SELECT p.post_id, p.title, p.content, p_ui.nickname, -- 1. recommend -> 추천이 있는지 여부 count(r.post_id) recommendCnt, -- 2. 내 추천인지 if(sum(CASE WHEN r_ul.username = #{username} THEN 1 OR 0 END) > 0, 'Y', 'N') myRecommend FROM post p JOIN -- 작성자 : post -> info_id -> nickname user_info p_ui ON p.info_id = p_ui.info_id LEFT JOIN -- recommend -> LEFT JOIN recommend r USING (post_id) LEFT JOIN user_info r_ui ON r.info_id = r_ui.info_id LEFT JOIN user_login r_ul ON r_ui.login_id = r_ul.login_id GROUP BY post_id
